models.title: Net sales after returns and allowances
models.summary: The practice solution subtracts returns and allowances from the amount charged for goods sold to determine recognized net revenue.

relationship.original_equation: Net sales = gross sales − sales returns and allowances
relationship.translation_notes: All values are monetary flows for the same reporting period.

variables.context: Same reporting entity, accounting basis, reporting period and currency

assumptions: Gross sales and contra-revenue have matching entity, accounting period and sales scope; amounts are measured in the same currency.
Returns and allowances are positive deductions, included only once; any separately applicable sales discounts must also be included in contra-revenue.
limitations: The calculation does not by itself establish whether a transaction meets revenue-recognition criteria.
Industry and accounting-policy definitions of gross sales and discounts can differ.
